selection_rule: Keep candidates whose fixed-validation ERB and contralateral high-frequency errors do not regress by more than 0.5 percent from v3, and whose horizontal strict ILD improves. All eligible candidates advance to 44-subject strict MATLAB reconstruction.

fixed_validation_frontier.note: No single candidate dominates the others on fixed validation; final selection requires strict reconstruction metrics.
